1481.result:
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        T2.Segment,
        T1.CustomerID,
        SUM(T1.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS T1
    INNER JOIN customers AS T2
        ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE
        T2.Currency = 'CZK'
        AND T2.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
        AND T1.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY
        T2.Segment,
        T1.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total_consumption
    FROM yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_average AS (
    SELECT
        T1.Segment,
        SUM(T1.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearly_consumption AS T1
    INNER JOIN min_consumption AS T2
        ON T1.Segment = T2.Segment
        AND T1.total_consumption = T2.min_total_consumption
    GROUP BY T1.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_difference,

    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_difference,

    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_difference;

WITH segment_percentage AS (
    SELECT
        T1.Segment,
        (
            SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
            SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
        ) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END), 0)
        AS percentage_increase
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2
        ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY T1.Segment
)
SELECT Segment
FROM segment_percentage
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM segment_percentage)
   OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM segment_percentage)
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC;
